message.description: The message to show the user in chat. Empty (or only whitespace) sends nothing, so a workflow can notify only when an earlier step found a change

context.description: Optional short context label (e.g. 'Task: deploy app', 'Follow-up on research')

related_session_id.description: Optional session ID to resume an existing conversation

needs.description: Set "action" when the user must do or decide something (an API needs a key, apply to this job?). It also creates an item for the user in their Feed, with this conversation as its thread. Leave it out for something to read (a brief, a report).

ask.description: Required with needs: "action". What exactly the user must do or decide, and what is blocked until they do, in one or two sentences — e.g. 'Sign up at https://x.dev and add X_API_KEY to docker-compose.yml; I can ingest the API after that.' The item records which run, workflow or agent sent it by itself.
